headline: Cloud growth continues but margins compress
summary_short: Revenue rose 9.4% y/y to $420.7M (down 2.2% q/q) on 28% y/y Pega Cloud growth, but operating income fell 55.0% q/q and 3.5% y/y to $16.6M as G&A jumped on litigation costs and restructuring, pushing diluted EPS down to $0.08.
summary_long: Pega Cloud revenue grew 28% y/y on expanded client adoption, offsetting declines in maintenance (clients shifting to cloud) and consulting (fewer Americas billable hours). Annual contract value (ACV) growth slowed sharply to 7% y/y (8% constant currency) as "unprecedented changes in the AI market caused clients to delay their purchasing decisions," a headwind management expects to persist through year-end. G&A rose 38% y/y on $11.5M of added litigation-related legal fees, and restructuring costs rose on severance tied to an AI-first delivery-model realignment, compressing operating income 55.0% q/q to $16.6M. The company repurchased $201.6M of stock in the quarter and paid a $0.03/share dividend, drawing cash to $185.1M from $270.0M. No numeric forward guidance was given in the filing.
